$(\Omega ,\overline g)$ has finite volume.
Proof

\sketch Integrating $\frac{d}{dt}\vol (M,g(t))=-\int _MR\, d\vol _M$ and using (Rlowerbound) gives $\vol (M,g(t))\leq \const +\const t^{3/2}$ for $t<T$, hence the limit region has finite volume.

□

Lemma
[existence for structure at the first singularity time]
